# An override implements one declaration for one target, and names the target
# on its own declaration line: `component X[html.platform] { ... }`. The rule
# is the same wherever the override is written -- a platform package's own
# overrides in codegen/platform/*/*.sngl say it the same way.

# A program overrides its own component. On the named target the override is
# the body; everywhere else the declaration's own body is.
sngl generate --platform html --lang none -o out_html app.sngl
grep '<img' out_html/index.html
! grep 'avatar fallback' out_html/index.html

sngl generate --platform bubbletea --lang go -o out_bt app.sngl
grep 'avatar fallback' out_bt/model.go

# The target is resolved, not read as text: only a target whose package this
# build loaded can be named, so a misspelling is reported where it is written
# rather than becoming an override nothing selects.
! sngl check typo.sngl
stderr 'undefined: htlm'

# And it has to be a target identity. Anything else the name resolves to is
# refused rather than taken for one.
! sngl check nottarget.sngl
stderr 'is not a target identity'

# Two implementations of one declaration for one target are two answers to a
# question with one. The html platform package already implements sngl.badge.
! sngl check duplicate.sngl
stderr 'already has an implementation for "html"'

# The same, for a component this package declares itself. Named unqualified,
# because there is no namespace it was reached through -- the message used to
# print a bare "." in front of it.
! sngl check duplicatelocal.sngl
stderr 'component gap already has an implementation for "html"'

# An override's prop list names the props its body reads -- a selection of what
# the declaration it overrides declares. The types stay with the base, so
# restating one is an error, and a name the base does not declare is too.
! sngl check declaresprops.sngl
stderr 'its type belongs to the declaration being overridden'

! sngl check selectsunknown.sngl
stderr 'selects "bogus", which Avatar does not declare'

# A prop the override did not select is not in scope for its body.
! sngl check unselected.sngl
stderr 'undefined: size'

# And the list is optional: without one the override reads every prop, which is
# what every platform package's override does.
sngl check noselection.sngl
stdout 'noselection.sngl: ok'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:platform/html"

component Avatar(url string, size int) node {
    text(value="avatar fallback: " + url)
}

component Avatar[html.platform] {
    html.img(src=url, alt="avatar")
}

window #w(title="t") {
    Avatar(url="/a.png", size=32)
}

-- typo.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component Avatar(url string) node {
    text(value=url)
}

component Avatar[htlm.platform] {
    text(value=url)
}

window #w(title="t") {
    Avatar(url="/a.png")
}

-- nottarget.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:platform/html"

component Avatar(url string) node {
    text(value=url)
}

component Avatar[html.element] {
    text(value=url)
}

window #w(title="t") {
    Avatar(url="/a.png")
}

-- duplicatelocal.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:platform/html"

component gap(w int) ui.node

component gap[html.platform](w) {
    ui.text(value="a")
}

component gap[html.platform](w) {
    ui.text(value="b")
}

ui.window #w(title="t") {
    gap(w=1)
}

-- duplicate.sngl --
import sngl "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:platform/html"

component sngl.badge[html.platform] {
    html.span(textContent=value)
}

component main root {
    window #w(title="t") {
        badge(value="7")
    }
}

-- declaresprops.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:platform/html"

component Avatar(url string) node {
    text(value=url)
}

component Avatar[html.platform](url string) {
    text(value=url)
}

window #w(title="t") {
    Avatar(url="/a.png")
}

-- selectsunknown.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:platform/html"

component Avatar(url string) node {
    text(value=url)
}

component Avatar[html.platform](url, bogus) {
    html.img(src=url)
}

window #w(title="t") {
    Avatar(url="/a.png")
}

-- unselected.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:platform/html"

component Avatar(url string, size int) node {
    text(value=url)
}

component Avatar[html.platform](url) {
    html.img(src=url, width=size)
}

window #w(title="t") {
    Avatar(url="/a.png", size=1)
}

-- noselection.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:platform/html"

component Avatar(url string, size int) node {
    text(value=url)
}

component Avatar[html.platform] {
    html.img(src=url, alt=string(size))
}

window #w(title="t") {
    Avatar(url="/a.png", size=1)
}
